problem_text:
A distribution network seeks to allocate a certain quantity of goods from a series of regional warehouses to a set of retail outlets, with the objective of minimizing the aggregate delivery expense.

The inventory available at each warehouse (set W) is precisely as follows:
*Warehouse W1 holds 169 units.
*Warehouse W2 holds 115 units.
*Warehouse W3 holds 144 units.
*Warehouse W4 holds 92 units.
*Warehouse W5 holds 79 units.

The required fulfillment quantity for each retail outlet (set R) is detailed below:
*Outlet R1 requires 34 units.
*Outlet R2 requires 64 units.
*Outlet R3 requires 118 units.
*Outlet R4 requires 189 units.
*Outlet R5 requires 117 units.

The per-unit transportation cost from each warehouse to each outlet is provided in the following matrix:

| From / To | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 |
|-----------|----|----|----|----|----|
| W1        | 13 | 13 | 7  | 3  | 19 |
| W2        | 8  | 4  | 10 | 20 | 4  |
| W3        | 19 | 2  | 12 | 18 | 14 |
| W4        | 12 | 3  | 17 | 11 | 1  |
| W5        | 14 | 16 | 4  | 14 | 12 |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the lowest possible total logistical expenditure.
